Given an open-ended user request, our system autonomously composes realistic, diverse, and simulation-ready 3D environments. The generated scenes are directly deployable in modern simulators, supporting embodied tasks such as Mobile Manipulation and Pick-and-Place. The agent dynamically calls generators (Scene Init, Asset Placer/Mover/Remover) to construct and refine layouts, while visual and physics critics provide iterative feedback for self-improvement.
